title: Loom flags a stale note. It does not rewrite it.
friendlyTitle: Loom marks a stale note. It does not rewrite it.
summary: ClickHouse released Loom, an open-source store that keeps agent notes next to a code index. On the company's own questions about the ClickHouse codebase, it says the mean answer-quality score rose from 0.78 to 0.84 after Loom was added. A note tied to a function is flagged if that code changes.
friendlySummary: ClickHouse released Loom, an open-source store that keeps agent notes next to an index of the code. On the company's own questions about the ClickHouse codebase, it says the average answer-quality score rose from 0.78 to 0.84 after Loom was added. A note tied to a function is flagged if that code changes.
whyItMatters: That score is ClickHouse's, on its own repository. Loom does not rewrite a stale note for you. Two agents can share a namespace only if you point them at the same deployment, and you still decide what is allowed to be shared. A memory of the code is not a review of the change.
